          https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide

wllama/   wllama 3.8.1 (llama.cpp compiled to WebAssembly), by Xuan Son Nguyen

wllama-compat/  wllama-compat 3.8.1, the build for browsers without JSPI or 64-bit
          WebAssembly memory, such as Safari. Same author and licence as wllama.
